{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season | year = 2018–19 | team = Minnesota Golden Gophers | sport = basketball | logo = Minnesota Golden Gophers logo.svg | logo_size = | logo_alt = | image = | image_size = | image_alt = | conference = Big Ten Conference | short_conf = Big Ten | CoachRank = | APRank = | record = 22–14 | conf_record = 9–11 | head_coach = [[Richard Pitino]] | hc_year = 6th | asst_coach1 = [[Ed Conroy (basketball)|Ed Conroy]] | ac1_year = 3rd | asst_coach2 = [[Rob Jeter]] | ac2_year = 1st | asst_coach3 = Kyle Lindsted | ac3_year = 1st | captain = | captain_year = | arena = [[Williams Arena]] | champion = Vancouver Showcase champions | tourney = [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] | tourney_result = Second Round }} {{2018–19 Big Ten men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Minnesota]] in the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Gophers, led by sixth-year head coach [[Richard Pitino]], played their home games at [[Williams Arena]] in [[Minneapolis|Minneapolis, Minnesota]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. The team was led by [[2018–19 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|2019]] First team All-[[Big Ten Conference|Big Ten]] selection [[Jordan Murphy (basketball)|Jordan Murphy]] and third team selection [[Amir Coffey]].{{cite web |url=https://bigten.org/news/2019/3/11/big-ten-unveils-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-on-btn.aspx |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190327091011/https://bigten.org/news/2019/3/11/big-ten-unveils-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-on-btn.aspx |url-status=dead |archive-date=March 27, 2019 |title=Big Ten Unveils Men's Basketball Postseason Honors on BTN |accessdate=March 11, 2019 |date=March 11, 2019 |website=BigTen.org}} They finished the season 22-14, 9-11 in [[2018–19 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten Play]] to finish in 7th place. They defeated [[2018–19 Penn State Nittany Lions basketball team|Penn State]] and [[2018–19 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team|Purdue]] to advance to the semifinals of the [[2019 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], where they lost to [[2018–19 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], where they defeated [[2018–19 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|Louisville]] in the first round before losing in the second round to [[2018–19 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]]. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team|Golden Gophers]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 15–17, 4–14 in [[2017–18 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in a three-way tie for 11th place. As the No. 11 seed in the [[2018 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they lost in the first round to [[2017–18 Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball team|Rutgers]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
